content: Bepaŋ adi kweboboe uŋgoniŋ foloŋ yokwet wapum tutumbaguk.
Yahwe adi Isilae kwetneŋ yokwet noli ila ugiŋ u yabukahile tuguk, iŋgoŋ Jelusalem adi kanadigalika hinek tuguk.
Bepaŋ yolikweli wapum diniŋ metam, hidi indiŋ nadineŋ. Bepaŋ adi nemek loloŋnit eŋ momomomooŋ tihamulak wondok metam feedi youtumba tiiŋ.
Bepaŋdi indiŋ yolak, “Metambop nediyeŋ medene takaliiŋ u yehikunali, Isiphi gut Babilonhi maaŋ yehikunalit. Tiŋa undugoŋ, Filistiahi tiŋa Taiyahi eŋ Itiopiahi adi maaŋ undugoŋ Jelusalemhi yenimbit.
“Nu Jelusalemdok adi indiŋ yobit, ‘Woŋ adi metam hogohogok’walaŋ yohikwehik.’ Bepaŋ Loloŋnit na Jelusalem tubufafaŋewene fafaŋeniŋ undugoŋ halaak.”
Yahwe adi metambop noli’walaŋ wohiye youlaak, tiŋa yehikiula Jelusalemhi metam dut noŋgoŋ yehikunalaak.
Kaŋ metam Jelusalem uŋoŋ hatineeŋdi kap toŋa nadifo tiŋa miyeneeŋ. Tiŋa indiŋ yoneeŋ, “Jelusalem, nemenemek momohi u du’walaŋkade hadapmalak.”
